title: Mar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Kamma 112a (112b in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.112b.16): Ravina waited twelve months for Mar Acha ([Rashi explains](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Bava_Kamma.112b.16.1): this is his name). It is not known whether he was a Torah scholar.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage says that Ravina delayed for twelve months for a caravan to return from Bei Chozai.
Rashi identifies Mar Acha as the man’s name and describes him as a creditor whose debtor was out of town. Hyman leaves his status as a Torah scholar open.
